project_type: pnpm/turbo TypeScript monorepo with a Next.js 15 App Router web app and shared core/types packages
build_system: pnpm 11 workspace monorepo with Turbo; apps/web uses Next.js 15, strict TypeScript, path aliases, and client components for browser-only local AI
test_framework: Vitest 3.0.7 from the repository root; focused web utility tests live under apps/web/lib/__tests__; no component-test framework is configured
verification_instructions: Run the focused Vitest command, then pnpm --filter @quiz-creator/web typecheck and pnpm --filter @quiz-creator/web build. Manually verify pasted definitions, structured question/answer input, empty input, parser/model-unavailable fallback, encoded-slug navigation, and add/edit persistence on the quiz overview.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Next build output is apps/web/.next and is not a source deliverable; do not edit generated .next-dev or .next files.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell workspace at C:\Users\User\IntelliJ\quiz-creator; SmolLM2/getPipeline is browser-only and must remain behind use-client interaction handlers; do not send project content to external APIs or add runtime dependencies.
contribution_requirements: Follow README.md and .kiro/steering/codebase-navigation.md; keep changes minimal, preserve strict typing, do not change server routes for browser-only behavior, and do not modify unrelated AI generation flows.
key_patterns: ManualQuizCreator uses parseSmartClipboard first, keeps question_answer verbatim, queues bulk imports, and falls back asynchronously to parseWithSmolLM2. RichTextEditor accepts onPaste and normalizes programmatic innerHTML. QuizQuestionFormModal owns one-card POST/PATCH/DELETE state and QuizOverviewClient supplies it from the encoded quiz route. convertToQuestion is already tested and phraseIdentificationPrompt is covered in core tests.
directory_structure: apps/web/components/quiz contains manual and overview authoring UI; apps/web/lib contains deterministic clipboard/converter utilities and client AI adapters; apps/web/app/(app)/quizzes/[quizId] renders the overview; apps/web/app/api/quizzes/[quizId]/questions handles persistence; packages/core/src/services contains reusable deterministic transformations; .agents/tasks stores workflow artifacts outside the source worktree deliverables.
source_corrections: The established facts are consistent with the inspected source except localClipboardParser's internal SmolLMParsedCard field is named question while its returned ParsedClipboard field is definition; no behavior change is required. The manual creator already contains parser/model handling, so integration means centralizing its transformation and adding the missing overview modal handling rather than adding a new parser implementation.
